alice_support: FYI - Acme reported intermittent parse failures when using JSON mode in streaming responses. Errors look like `invalid JSON: unexpected token '\uFFFD' at position 234` and sometimes a 402 billing error shows up in the same session. They can repro ~10% of requests.

ben_eng: Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the exact model + settings (streaming, max_tokens, stop seq)? Also include `x-request-id` from logs if available.

alice_support: Repro shown below. model: `redwood-open-16k`, streaming: true, max_tokens: 2048. `x-request-id`  = `req-0a1b2c3d`. curl: 
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-16k","stream":true,"input":"<user prompt>"}'
```
Response fragment from their capture: `...{"choices":[{"delta":"{\"items\": [\"ok\"\x00\"]}` then stream cuts off.

carmen_ml: Looks like two things colliding: streaming truncation leaving trailing control chars (\x00-\x1F) and a separate billing surface returning 402 that occasionally interrupts the stream. Plan: short-term sanitizer + re-ask, medium-term streaming trailer detection + jittered backoff for billing.

ben_eng: For immediate mitigation suggest 3-step flow: 1) Fast sanitizer: run a regex strip on the final string to remove non-printables before JSON.parse, 2) If parse still fails, trigger a targeted re-ask prompt that includes the last valid partial JSON and explicit schema, 3) If billing/402 seen, respond with exponential backoff + circuit-breaker and surface friendly message to caller.

alice_support: Example sanitizer regex (JS): `const cleaned = raw.replace(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/g, '');` Works for their captured \x00 byte. Also added trim of trailing commas: `cleaned.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1')`.

ben_eng: Re-ask prompt template we used: 
```
You are a JSON assistant. The user output must exactly match this schema: {"items": [string]}
We received this partial output: "<partial>", which failed to parse. Please return the corrected full JSON only, no extra text.
```
Include `max_output_tokens: 200` and `top_p:0.9` to reduce hallucination.

carmen_ml: Also try lightweight heuristics before re-asking: 1) detect unclosed braces / brackets, 2) run `balanceScore` & if score within 1 bracket, try auto-close append `}` or `]`, 3) if trailing garbage after JSON, cut at last `}` and sanitize.

dmitri_sre: On the infra side: add detection for `502/stream-truncated` + `402` combo in logs and correlate to `x-request-id`. When 402 occurs, flag session and avoid re-asking immediately — instead push into a short-queue with exponential backoff: base 500ms * 2^n + jitter(0-200ms), max attempts 4. Also add metric `support.parse_retries` with labels (sanitizer|reask|giveup).

alice_support: Customer followed the sanitizer and re-ask flow and saw parse success go from ~90% to ~99.6%. They still hit billing 402 separately; SRE is investigating billing race.

ben_eng: Action items: 
- carmen_ml: draft canonical re-ask prompt + include explicit schema example and a small set of test prompts.
- dmitri_sre: add log spike rule for `402+stream-truncate` with runbook link.
- alice_support: send sanitized repro to customer for validation and update the support ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployed hotfix branch `stream-sanitizer-v1` to staging (deploy id: deploy-2024-11-01-07). :rocket:

carmen_ml: I'll add unit tests for control char stripping + trailing comma fixes. Example unit test snippet: `expect(parse(sanitize('{"items":["a"\x00]'))).toEqual({items:["a"]})`.

alice_support: Thanks all. I'll mark this as escalated -> SRE billing track and follow up in ticket. :white_check_mark:
